      • property

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonOperator property​(String property)
        Starts a comparison of a property of the node to something.

      • length

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonOperator length​(String property)
        Starts a comparison of the length of a property of the node to something.

      • name

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonOperator name()
        Starts a comparison of the JCR name of the node to something.

        Limitation: this won't work right on the topmost versioned node (often jcr:content) since that is renamed to jcr:frozenNode in the version storage. Please consider using Query.element(String) if you make a simple equality comparison, which can take this into account.

      • localName

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonOperator localName()
        Starts a comparison of the JCR local name (i.e., without the namespace) of a property of the node to something.

        Limitation: this won't work right on the topmost versioned node (often jcr:content) since that is renamed to jcr:frozenNode in the version storage. Please consider using Query.element(String) if you make a simple equality comparison, which can take this into account.

      • score

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonOperator score()
        Starts a comparison of the score of the full-text search score of a node to something.

      • lower

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonStart lower()
        Applies LOWER (lowercase) to the following dynamic operand.

      • upper

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonStart upper()
        Applies UPPER (uppercase) to the following dynamic operand.

      • selector

        public QueryConditionDsl.ComparisonStart selector​(String nextSelector)
        Use the specified selector for (only) the next condition - for use with complicated joins. Normally just use the condition in Query.join(Query.JoinType, Query.JoinCondition, String, QueryCondition).
        See Also:
        Query.join(Query.JoinType, Query.JoinCondition, String, QueryCondition), Query.joinConditionBuilder()
